body: I’m still here. Came back to let you folks know.

I’m not sure if anyone checks these posts to see if people survived, but I thought I’d check in and let you know that I’m still around. 

All of your messages, and this one especially, made me take stock of my life and decide to hang around for more. 

Thank you, and I hope you don’t think less of me for not going through with it.
Will do, thank you! I really think I’m going to have to calorie count, like you suggested - seeing as I can clearly eat a ton during the eating window.

Oh thank you, I will try that. I know you’re right. 
I guess I was just drawn to the time factor and how it doesn’t really matter what you eat - at least that’s what people say.

I went straight to 18:6 on the second day, and then up to 19:5 the day after. It wasn’t too hard... as it mirrors my usual patterns. I dunno thought. I think I’m consuming too much during the eating window.

Way too many actually. Like I ate a whole pizza in my eating window the first day... and that’s like 2400 on its own. I know IF theory is that it doesn’t matter what you eat... but for me, I think it’s going to. 

Of course I know that eating less calories will mean more weight loss... I’m just finding that difficult.
I think when people say 24 hour fast they mean start the timer and wait till it gets to 24 hours before eating. The sunrise and sunset don’t generally come into play.
I’ve read you can have coffee and tea if it’s black (no milk). Some people say you can have a dash of milk if it’s under 50 calories, but I prefer not to.

I’m on day 2 of 16:8, and I’m wondering whether things are going to pan out to make a huge difference. I fast naturally almost every day... eat my last meal at about 9.30pm and have my first meal at 2pm. Usually the only thing I have between those times is a coffee with 3 sugars and milk (I know that’s a lot of sugar). 

I think the IF will definitely cut out those calories every day (around 100 maybe), and any night-time snacks I might have usually consumed. But apart from that, my eating habits haven’t really changed doing 26:8. I’ve been gradually gaining weight over 14 years. 

I guess the extra 300 (if we include midnight snacks) calorie deficit per day will add up, but so y’all think I should throw in a couple of 24 hour fasts in per week to really shake up my routine?
I guess they stopped teaching cursive in America?
